title: Tiny11 Handheld Build Configuration
description: Configuration schema for cross-platform Windows 11 image builder

name.description: Descriptive name for this build configuration

description.description: Detailed description of this build's purpose

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when configuration was created

isoPath.description: Path to Windows 11 source ISO file

checksum.description: SHA256 checksum of source ISO (optional, for validation)

architecture.description: CPU architecture of the Windows image

outputPath.description: Directory where output ISO will be created

compressionLevel.description: WIM compression level: none (fastest), fast, max (smallest), recovery (bootable)

removeEdge.description: Remove Microsoft Edge browser (may break some Windows features)

removeOneDrive.description: Remove OneDrive client and disable folder backup

removeList.description: List of package names to remove (e.g., Microsoft.WindowsAlarms)

keepList.description: List of package names to explicitly preserve even if in removeList

bypassSystemRequirements.description: Bypass Windows 11 system requirements checks (enables all bypass options below)

bypassTPM.description: Bypass TPM 2.0 requirement (SECURITY RISK if used on internet-connected systems)

bypassSecureBoot.description: Bypass Secure Boot requirement (SECURITY RISK if used on internet-connected systems)

componentCleanup.description: Run component cleanup to remove superseded components

resetBase.description: Reset base of superseded components (further reduces size)

removeWinSxSBackups.description: Remove WinSxS backup files (CAUTION: prevents component repair)

inject.description: Inject custom drivers into the image

driverPath.description: Path to directory containing .inf driver files

inject.description: Inject Windows Updates into the image

updatePath.description: Path to directory containing .msu or .cab update files

oemPath.description: Path to directory containing OEM files

packagesJsonPath.description: Path to packages.json defining post-install applications
